title.en: Past simple: I walked, I went, I won
title.sl: Past simple: preteklik (I walked, I went)
title.it: Il past simple: il passato (I walked, I went)
title.de: Das past simple: die Vergangenheit (I walked, I went)

rule.en:
The past simple is for something finished, at a time that is over: **yesterday**, **last week**, **in 2020**, **two days ago**.

Regular verbs add **-ed**, the same for every person: walk → **walked**, jump → **jumped**, play → **played**. Spelling: like → **liked**, stop → **stopped**, carry → **carried**. It is one word, with no helping verb: **A fish jumped.** (not *A fish is jumped*).

Many common verbs are irregular; learn them with the verb: go → **went**, see → **saw**, win → **won**, make → **made**, come → **came**, find → **found**. **I won!** (not *I winned*).

Questions and negatives take **did** / **didn't** + the base form: **Did you see it?** **I didn't go.** (not *I didn't went*).

**be** has two forms: **was** (I, he, she, it) and **were** (you, we, they): **It was cold.** **We were at the lake.** Negative: **wasn't**, **weren't**; question: **Were you there?** (no did).
rule.sl:
*past simple* je za nekaj končanega, v času, ki je mimo: **yesterday**, **last week**, **in 2020**, **two days ago** (pred dvema dnevoma).

Pravilni glagoli dobijo **-ed**, za vse osebe enako: walk → **walked**, jump → **jumped**, play → **played**. Pravopis: like → **liked**, stop → **stopped**, carry → **carried**. Je ena sama beseda, brez pomožnika, kot ga ima slovenski *je skočila*: **A fish jumped.** (Riba je skočila; ne *A fish is jumped*.)

Veliko pogostih glagolov je nepravilnih, uči se jih skupaj z glagolom: go → **went**, see → **saw**, win → **won**, make → **made**, come → **came**, find → **found**. **I won!** (ne *I winned*).

Vprašanje in zanikanje: **did** / **didn't** + osnovna oblika: **Did you see it?** (Si to videl?) **I didn't go.** (ne *I didn't went*).

**be** ima dve obliki: **was** (I, he, she, it) in **were** (you, we, they): **It was cold.** (Bilo je mrzlo.) **We were at the lake.** Zanikanje: **wasn't**, **weren't**; vprašanje: **Were you there?** (brez did).
rule.it:
Il *past simple* è per un'azione conclusa, in un tempo finito: **yesterday**, **last week**, **in 2020**, **two days ago** (due giorni fa). Dove l'italiano parlato usa il passato prossimo (ieri ho visto una volpe), l'inglese usa questo: **Yesterday I saw a fox.**

I verbi regolari prendono **-ed**, uguale per tutte le persone: walk → **walked**, jump → **jumped**, play → **played**. Ortografia: like → **liked**, stop → **stopped**, carry → **carried**. È una parola sola, senza ausiliare: **A fish jumped.** (È saltato un pesce; non *A fish is jumped*.)

Molti verbi comuni sono irregolari, da imparare con il verbo: go → **went**, see → **saw**, win → **won**, make → **made**, come → **came**, find → **found**. **I won!** (non *I winned*).

Domande e negazioni: **did** / **didn't** + forma base: **Did you see it?** (L'hai visto?) **I didn't go.** (non *I didn't went*).

**be** ha due forme: **was** (I, he, she, it) e **were** (you, we, they): **It was cold.** (Faceva freddo.) **We were at the lake.** Negazione: **wasn't**, **weren't**; domanda: **Were you there?** (senza did).
rule.de:
Das *past simple* steht für Abgeschlossenes, zu einer Zeit, die vorbei ist: **yesterday**, **last week**, **in 2020**, **two days ago** (vor zwei Tagen). Wo man im Deutschen meist das Perfekt sagt (ich habe gewonnen), steht im Englischen dieses: **I won!**

Regelmäßige Verben bekommen **-ed**, gleich für alle Personen: walk → **walked**, jump → **jumped**, play → **played**. Schreibung: like → **liked**, stop → **stopped**, carry → **carried**. Es ist ein Wort, ohne Hilfsverb: **A fish jumped.** (Ein Fisch ist gesprungen; nicht *A fish is jumped*.)

Viele häufige Verben sind unregelmäßig, lerne sie mit dem Verb: go → **went**, see → **saw**, win → **won**, make → **made**, come → **came**, find → **found**: **I won**, nicht *I winned*.

Frage und Verneinung: **did** / **didn't** + Grundform: **Did you see it?** (Hast du es gesehen?) **I didn't go.** (nicht *I didn't went*).

**be** hat zwei Formen: **was** (I, he, she, it) und **were** (you, we, they): **It was cold.** (Es war kalt.) **We were at the lake.** Verneinung: **wasn't**, **weren't**; Frage: **Were you there?** (ohne did).

examples.de: Gestern sind wir nach Keswick gefahren.

examples.en: A fish jumped out of the water.
examples.it: Un pesce è saltato fuori dall'acqua.
examples.de: Ein Fisch ist aus dem Wasser gesprungen.

note.en: Just jumped: no is, no has.
note.sl: Samo jumped: brez is, brez has.
note.it: Solo jumped: niente is, niente has.
note.de: Nur jumped: kein is, kein has.

examples.en: We saw a red squirrel in the wood.
examples.sl: V gozdu smo videli rdečo veverico.
examples.it: Nel bosco abbiamo visto uno scoiattolo rosso.
examples.de: Im Wald haben wir ein rotes Eichhörnchen gesehen.

examples.en: Did you find the lamb? — Yes, it was behind the wall.
examples.sl: Ste našli jagnje? — Ja, bilo je za zidom.
examples.it: Avete trovato l'agnello? — Sì, era dietro il muro.
examples.de: Habt ihr das Lamm gefunden? — Ja, es war hinter der Mauer.

note.en: did + find (not did you found); be → was.
note.sl: did + find (ne did you found); be → was.
note.it: did + find (non did you found); be → was.
note.de: did + find (nicht did you found); be → was.

examples.en: It was very cold, so we didn't go up the fell.
examples.sl: Bilo je zelo mrzlo, zato nismo šli na hrib.
examples.it: Faceva molto freddo, quindi non siamo saliti in montagna.
examples.de: Es war sehr kalt, also sind wir nicht auf den Berg gegangen.

examples.en: Granny Maggie made scones for us.
examples.sl: Babica Maggie nam je spekla pogačice.
examples.it: Nonna Maggie ci ha fatto gli scones.
examples.de: Oma Maggie hat uns Scones gebacken.
